fixes.explanation: Let's look at what the text says, friend. Nebuchadnezzar "…cut into pieces all the gold articles that Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the LORD." (2 Kings 24:13). Solomon was Israel's king long before this. What the verse tells us is that the articles were cut into pieces.

Yes, baker. "…the king of Babylon made Mattaniah, Jehoiachin’s uncle, king in his place and changed his name to Zedekiah." (2 Kings 24:17). The text says Babylon's king made him king. Mattaniah, Jehoiachin's uncle, is the one who gets the job. He even gave him a new name, Zedekiah.
